transcript.analyst: EWY reads as a levered short on paper — ADX 46.5 confirms a strong trend, it's the worst relative performer (-7.52%) in the memory complex, structure is mildly crowded long (1.237) leaving squeeze-fuel, and macro/sentiment (Korean sovereign stress, BoK hike risk, foreign selling into Samsung prelims) is genuinely bearish. The problem is timing, not direction. Price is pinned at the very bottom of its Bollinger channel (bb_pctb 0.032) with 5m RSI 20.7, 15m RSI 30.7, stoch 28 — classic short-term exhaustion — right after KOSPI ripped +5.8% July 3, a tape proven capable of violent 5-10% one-day snapbacks. Shorting the low band into that, with live binaries (Samsung prelim earnings, SK Hynix ADR debut July 10) inside the window, is the extended-mid-air entry the playbook warns against. A structure-respecting stop near VWAP/SMA20 (~192-193) compresses R:R to support 174.6 to ~1.2 with high reversion risk. Disciplined play: wait — sell a bounce toward VWAP (short into strength) or short a decisive break of 174.6. Armed the trigger at 174.6 so an early-but-correct short converts to a timely entry when support fails. Longs off the table.
